1/**
2 * Visibility and Culling Functions
3 * Handles frustum culling, transfer function culling, and camera movement detection
4 */
5
6export const CULLING_CONFIG = {
7 MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD: 0.5, // Position threshold (world units)
8 ROTATION_THRESHOLD: 0.05 // Direction threshold (radians)
9};
10
11// Computed constants
12const MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD_SQ = CULLING_CONFIG.MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * CULLING_CONFIG.MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD;
13const ROT_DOT_THRESHOLD = Math.cos(CULLING_CONFIG.ROTATION_THRESHOLD);
14
15/**
16 * Check if camera has moved significantly since last position
17 * @param {Object} camera - Camera object with position and direction
18 * @param {Object} lastPosition - Last recorded camera position
19 * @param {Object} lastDirection - Last recorded camera direction
20 * @returns {{hasMoved: boolean, position: Object, direction: Object}} Movement result
21 */
22export function checkCameraMovement(camera, lastPosition, lastDirection) {
23 if (!camera) return { hasMoved: false, position: lastPosition, direction: lastDirection };
24
25 if (!lastPosition || !lastDirection) {
26 // First check - consider camera as moved
27 return {
28 hasMoved: true,
29 position: { ...camera.position },
30 direction: { ...camera.direction }
31 };
32 }
33
34 // Check position change (squared distance to avoid sqrt)
35 const dx = camera.position.x - lastPosition.x;
36 const dy = camera.position.y - lastPosition.y;
37 const dz = camera.position.z - lastPosition.z;
38 const posChangeSq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
39
40 // Check direction change using dot product vs cosine threshold
41 const dot = (camera.direction.x * lastDirection.x) +
42 (camera.direction.y * lastDirection.y) +
43 (camera.direction.z * lastDirection.z);
44 const hasRotated = dot < ROT_DOT_THRESHOLD;
45 const hasMoved = posChangeSq > MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD_SQ || hasRotated;
46
47 if (hasMoved) {
48 return {
49 hasMoved: true,
50 position: { ...camera.position },
51 direction: { ...camera.direction }
52 };
53 }
54
55 return { hasMoved: false, position: lastPosition, direction: lastDirection };
56}

58/**
59 * Check if a brick is visible based on frustum and transfer function
60 * @param {Object} brick - Brick object with position and palette
61 * @param {number} brickSize - Size of brick
62 * @param {Object} camera - Camera object
63 * @param {Set} hiddenLabels - Set of hidden label IDs
64 * @returns {boolean} True if brick is visible
65 */
66export function isBrickVisible(brick, brickSize, camera, hiddenLabels) {
67 // Frustum culling: check if brick intersects camera frustum
68 if (!isBrickInFrustum(brick, brickSize, camera)) {
69 return false;
70 }
71
72 // Transfer function culling: check if brick has any visible voxels
73 if (!brickHasVisibleVoxels(brick, hiddenLabels)) {
74 return false;
75 }
76
77 return true;
78}
79
80/**
81 * Frustum culling: Check if brick AABB intersects camera frustum
82 * @param {Object} brick - Brick object with position
83 * @param {number} brickSize - Size of brick
84 * @param {Object} camera - Camera object with position, direction, and fov
85 * @returns {boolean} True if brick is in frustum
86 */
87export function isBrickInFrustum(brick, brickSize, camera) {
88 if (!camera) return true; // No camera = assume visible
89
90 // Brick AABB (axis-aligned bounding box)
91 const brickMin = brick.position;
92 const brickMax = {
93 x: brick.position.x + brickSize,
94 y: brick.position.y + brickSize,
95 z: brick.position.z + brickSize
96 };
97
98 // Brick center
99 const center = {
100 x: (brickMin.x + brickMax.x) / 2,
101 y: (brickMin.y + brickMax.y) / 2,
102 z: (brickMin.z + brickMax.z) / 2
103 };
104
105 // Vector from camera to brick center
106 const toCenter = {
107 x: center.x - camera.position.x,
108 y: center.y - camera.position.y,
109 z: center.z - camera.position.z
110 };
111
112 // Distance to brick center
113 const distance = Math.sqrt(toCenter.x * toCenter.x + toCenter.y * toCenter.y + toCenter.z * toCenter.z);
114
115 // Normalize direction to brick
116 const dirToBrick = {
117 x: toCenter.x / distance,
118 y: toCenter.y / distance,
119 z: toCenter.z / distance
120 };
121
122 // Dot product with camera direction (how aligned is brick with view direction)
123 const dot = dirToBrick.x * camera.direction.x +
124 dirToBrick.y * camera.direction.y +
125 dirToBrick.z * camera.direction.z;
126
127 // Brick diagonal radius (maximum distance from center to corner)
128 const brickRadius = Math.sqrt(3) * (brickSize / 2);
129
130 // FOV-based culling: brick must be within FOV cone + radius margin
131 // cos(fov/2) gives the minimum dot product for objects in view
132 const cosHalfFov = Math.cos(camera.fov / 2);
133
134 // Angular margin for brick visibility
135 // Use atan2 for accurate angular radius even at close distances
136 // This ensures bricks slightly outside the cone are still included
137 const angularRadius = Math.atan2(brickRadius, distance);
138
139 // Convert angular radius to a dot product threshold margin
140 // For small angles, sin(angle) ≈ margin in dot product space
141 const margin = Math.sin(angularRadius);
142
143 if (dot < cosHalfFov - margin) {
144 return false; // Outside FOV
145 }
146
147 // Behind camera check (with margin for partially visible bricks)
148 if (distance < -brickRadius) {
149 return false;
150 }
151
152 return true;
153}

155/**
156 * Transfer function culling: Check if brick palette has visible voxels
157 * Empty label is 0 (background from MICrONS dataset)
158 * @param {Object} brick - Brick object with palette array
159 * @param {Set} hiddenLabels - Set of hidden label IDs
160 * @returns {boolean} True if brick has at least one visible voxel
161 */
162export function brickHasVisibleVoxels(brick, hiddenLabels) {
163 // Check if ANY palette entry is non-zero (non-empty) and not hidden
164 for (const paletteValue of brick.palette) {
165 if (paletteValue !== 0n && !(hiddenLabels && hiddenLabels.has(paletteValue))) {
166 return true; // Has at least one non-empty, visible voxel
167 }
168 }
169
170 return false; // All palette entries are 0 (empty) or hidden
171}
